A scripted farm as a result has to pad 44 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 55 aliases cost 242 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
